Subject: Monthly service-health compact brief + QBR prep requests

Team —

Attached is a compact dashboard for May (top-line latency, cost, uptime, usage) that I want to use as the basis for our QBR with Acme next week. This is intentionally condensed — I want one slide we can walk executives through.

Top 3 observations (high level):
- Latency: 95th P95 increased from 120ms -> 185ms for the text-gen fleet on 5/17 and 5/23; both correlate with heavy long-sequence workloads.
- Cost: Token spend up ~11% month-over-month driven by increased seq length and repeated retries on retry-policy-2.
- Uptime: SLO at 99.92% for May; two short incidents (5/17 cache corruption, 5/23 autoscaler mis-scaling) contributed most of the error budget.

Asks ahead of QBR (please):
1) Markus — short written note (2–3 bullets) on root cause + corrective already in deploy for the 5/17 cache issue. Include ETA for full remediation.
2) Aditya — quick table with cost deltas by customer segment (PLG vs enterprise) and the impact of retry-policy-2; one row per major driver.
3) Laura — one slide (bullet + graph) that maps these metrics to our OKR health (Reliability and Cost Efficiency).

I attached the compact PDF and a starting slide deck outline. If we can have these back by EOD Monday I’ll stitch and share the QBR runbook.

Attachments: [Attachment: may-service-dashboard-compact.pdf (PDF, 980 KB)], [Attachment: qbr-slide-outline-v1.pptx (PPTX, 450 KB)]

Thanks —
Jonas

Jonas / Laura —

Quick root-cause notes for the 5/17 incident (for slide copy):
- What happened: a staged cache compaction job hit an off-by-one on a key eviction routine. Corrupt entries caused a small percentage of requests to miss soft-KV fast-path and fall back to cold loads, increasing tail latency.
- Impact: ~1.1% increase in 95th latency for text-gen; error spike lasted ~23 minutes during the compaction window.
- Fixes in flight: patch merged and rolling deploy scheduled (5/29 AM). Added a safety check to skip compaction on nodes with active KV locks.
- Longer-term: we will add compact job preflight checks and a canary window to the pipeline (Q3 roadmap).

Attachment: [Attachment: compact-rootcause-notes.txt (TXT, 12 KB)]

Markus
